from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(np.float32)/255
mx=im.max(2); mn=im.min(2); d=mx-mn
h=np.zeros_like(mx)
r,g,b=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
m=(d>1e-5)
mr=m&(mx==r); mg=m&(mx==g); mb=m&(mx==b)
h[mr]=((g[mr]-b[mr])/d[mr])%6
h[mg]=(b[mg]-r[mg])/d[mg]+2
h[mb]=(r[mb]-g[mb])/d[mb]+4
h/=6
s=d/(mx+1e-5); v=mx
# print bboxes for semantic masks
masks={
'orange':(h>0.02)&(h<0.14)&(s>0.45)&(v>0.25),
'blue':(h>0.5)&(h<0.72)&(s>0.18)&(v>0.12),
'wood':(h>0.02)&(h<0.13)&(s>0.25)&(v>0.15),
'white':(s<0.12)&(v>0.65),
'dark':(v<0.2),
'gray':(s<0.12)&(v>0.25)&(v<0.65),
}
for name,mask in masks.items():
 ys,xs=np.where(mask)
 print(name,len(xs),'bbox', (xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max()) if len(xs) else None)
# ascii 80x45 hue bins based average region
chars=' .:-=+*#%@'
for y in range(0,720,16):
 line=''
 for x in range(0,1280,16):
  p=im[y:y+16,x:x+16].mean((0,1)); rr,gg,bb=p; mm=max(p); nn=min(p); dd=mm-nn
  if mm<.15: c='K'
  elif dd<.07: c='W' if mm>.68 else ('G' if mm>.3 else 'k')
  elif rr>gg*1.12 and rr>bb*1.18: c='O' if dd>.3 else 'w'
  elif bb>rr*1.05 and bb>=gg*.92: c='B'
  elif gg>rr*1.05 and gg>bb*1.08: c='g'
  elif rr>bb*1.15 and gg>bb*1.1: c='y'
  else: c='?'
  line+=c
 print(line)
